sections.title: What is the LIC Jeevan Utsav plan (Plan 771)?

content.text: LIC Jeevan Utsav is a Non-Linked, Non-Participating, whole-life savings plan with a limited premium paying term (PPT) of 5 to 16 years. Its core feature is providing Guaranteed Additions of ₹40 per ₹1,000 Sum Assured during the PPT. After the PPT, it provides a lifetime income through one of two options: a 'Regular Income' of 10% of the Sum Assured annually, or a 'Flexi Income' option where you can defer and accumulate the income at a guaranteed 5.5% p.a. For full details, refer to the official LIC product page.

Premium & Mode Conversion

We start with the base annual premium and then apply LIC's official modal loading factors to calculate half-yearly, quarterly, and monthly premiums.

Guaranteed Additions (GAs)

GAs are ₹40 per ₹1,000 Basic Sum Assured (BSA) at the end of each policy year during the PPT only. None accrue after the PPT. Example: For a ₹10 Lakh BSA, the annual GA is (10,00,000 / 1000) * 40 = ₹40,000.

Income Options

  • Regular Income: 10% of BSA every year for life after PPT.
  • Flexi Income: Unclaimed income accrues at 5.5% p.a. compounded yearly; you can withdraw part of the accumulated pool.

Death Benefit (During/After PPT)

Death benefit = higher of (Sum Assured on Death) or (105% of total premiums paid up to date of death); Sum Assured on Death is defined in the brochure (commonly higher of BSA or 7× annualized premium, per LIC spec).

items.q: Regular vs Flexi — which is better?
What is the minimum Sum Assured?
items.a: The minimum Basic Sum Assured for Jeevan Utsav is ₹5,00,000.

items.q: Can I take a loan on this policy?
items.a: Yes, a loan is available after the policy has acquired a surrender value, which is typically after paying premiums for two full years.

As a whole life plan, Jeevan Utsav provides a lifetime income stream that starts after the premium paying term ends, not a single lump sum maturity payout like traditional endowment plans. The policy technically 'matures' at age 100.
It’s 10% of BSA income, not an IRR; Flexi accrual @ 5.5% for unwithdrawn income.

sections.title: Conclusion: A Lifelong Income Stream for a Secure Future

content.text: LIC's Jeevan Utsav is a powerful tool for anyone seeking a guaranteed, lifelong income stream after a limited premium payment period. Whether you choose the predictable 'Regular Income' or the flexible 'Flexi Income' option to grow your wealth, this plan is an excellent choice for creating a secure, lifelong financial legacy. It's best suited for individuals looking for a reliable, non-market-linked income stream in their post-retirement years, combining savings and protection in one powerful package.

mainEntity.name: What are Guaranteed Additions in Jeevan Utsav?

acceptedAnswer.text: Guaranteed Additions accrue @ ₹40 per ₹1,000 Basic Sum Assured at the end of each policy year during the premium paying term only.

mainEntity.name: What is the Regular vs Flexi Income?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular Income pays 10% of BSA each year for life after PPT. Flexi allows you to defer income; unclaimed income accrues @ ~5.5% p.a. compounding, with up to 75% withdrawal per year.
